discription: A simple FM synthesis sound with an ADSR envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, carRatio=1, modRatio=1, modIndex=1;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    var carrier = SinOsc.ar(freq * carRatio + (SinOsc.ar(freq * modRatio) * (freq * modIndex)));    sig = carrier * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
